response.sql: WITH joined_races AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, r.round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), circuit_averages AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_average_round FROM joined_races GROUP BY circuitId, country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_average_round FROM joined_races GROUP BY country) SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.circuit_average_round, ca.circuit_average_round - coa.country_average_round AS difference FROM circuit_averages AS ca JOIN country_averages AS coa ON ca.country IS coa.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The country average gives each race equal weight; AVG ignores NULL round values.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each circuit equal weight in its country's average by averaging the circuits' average rounds.
